truths.truth: One record of his sound: the native Speaker and /api/speaking both write Wake.talked, which Wake.air reads; the page's hold reads the same record; index.html has one 'is he making sound' test; /api/speaking records no placeholder span
truths.evidence: In app/server.py, Speaker._write calls Wake.talking(at, at+n/prate, paid, chunk=True) for sound chunks only, and Speaker.say calls Wake.owe(). /api/speaking calls talking_until(now + left), talking_until(now, None), owe or pay, and no 60/0.8 literal remains (grep 'talking_until' shows only :1597, :3952 and :3954). Every change publishes BUS t="voice" {left, owed, n}, and /api/events forwards the BUS unfiltered (Bus.pub, server.py:530). The page takes `voice` events and the /api/say, /api/say/stop and /api/speaking replies through takeRec. Its single `const sounding=()=>handing>0||vrec.owed>0||vrec.end>performance.now()` is the wait in untilQuiet, whenQuiet, followTry, heldTry and quietNative. A grep for playing/q.length/spkMap.size finds them only in face, idle, barge and player bookkeeping, never as a wait. The native trace was observed end to end, Speaker._write -> Wake.talked -> Wake.air -> Burst.rang -> echo drop, by the 'while it plays' FastScene. The pieces were also checked one at a time: NativeOwed.test_two_seconds_of_sound... (the span ends where _write put it) and test_air_says_whether_his_sound_and_its_ring_were_in_the_air_over_a_burst. The page trace /api/speaking {on,left} -> Wake.talked -> Wake.check was observed by PageSpeaking.test_speaking_on_records_talking_until_now_plus_left and test_its_good_said_after_the_page_went_quiet_is_a_follow_up.
